'''''Argent Lady''''' was a [[Cargo Empress-class super freighter|''Cargo Empress''-class super freighter]] manufactured by [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]] and owned by [[Cosmohaul Shipping]]. It was loaned to a group of freelance [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] by [[Paxtrell Snoygal]], in the hopes that the mercenaries could stop a [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] epidemic which was plaguing Cosmohaul's transports. Snoygal had hired a new crew to transport one hundred [[R5-series astromech droid]]s to [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. The crew turned out to be [[Xalto Sneerzick]], the leader of the [[Droid Abolitionist Movement]], and his followers, who were trying to free the droids. He had inserted an [[emancipation virus]] into their programming, but one of his droids rebelled and shot him. The ''Argent Lady'' was pursued and captured by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ship, but its crew was overtaken by the mercenaries and left stranded. The ''Argent Lady'' returned to Cosmohaul, but not before one of the infected R5 droids escaped in a [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]].<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Droids Defiant}}</ref>
